integrity: Contains complete proof, honest literature comparisons and standalone exact arithmetic checks. Finite computations do not stand in for the universal algebraic argument. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Full gap distribution is proved only when the larger generator is congruent to plus or minus two modulo the smaller odd generator. A larger family cannot be inferred from these formulas. Unindexed equivalent literature is a remaining priority risk.
title: Complete gap spectra of binary cyclotomic polynomials for residues \(\pm2\)
